status: bounded author correction; submitted for independent review; not semantic acceptance
changeSummary: Remove only the exact duplicate BoundaryOrTradeoff sentence from ErrorCorrection in all 18 items.

changedFields.before: Materializing all rows transfers detail that the screen never displays. If operators could inspect individual reservations inline, a bounded detail load for the selected station would be warranted.
changedFields.after: Materializing all rows transfers detail that the screen never displays.

changedFields.before: Taking a page after loading everything defeats the stated bound. If the list omitted gardener names, the plot page could be returned without loading gardeners.
changedFields.after: Taking a page after loading everything defeats the stated bound.

changedFields.before: Loading every child increases transfer and memory for values the query can aggregate. If the report later needs individual annotation text, it should use a separate detail query.
changedFields.after: Loading every child increases transfer and memory for values the query can aggregate.

changedFields.before: Deferred access can attempt I/O after the bounded read scope is gone. If the upload were performed inside a streaming database scope by design, resource lifetime would need an explicit separate decision.
changedFields.after: Deferred access can attempt I/O after the bounded read scope is gone.

changedFields.before: Deferred loads add hidden reads for fields guaranteed to be shown. If the grant set were unbounded or only a subset were displayed, a separate paged query could be preferable.
changedFields.after: Deferred loads add hidden reads for fields guaranteed to be shown.

changedFields.before: Eager loading transfers large optional notes for every aircraft. If replacement date must be derived from note history, the query should state that bounded aggregate explicitly.
changedFields.after: Eager loading transfers large optional notes for every aircraft.

changedFields.before: The broad load carries data outside the stated display contract. If capacity were not persisted and had to be calculated from active referrals, a controlled aggregate query would be needed.
changedFields.after: The broad load carries data outside the stated display contract.

changedFields.before: One hidden lookup per row scales query count with the rendered list. If each row also showed full owner history, that relationship would need its own explicit bounded access plan.
changedFields.after: One hidden lookup per row scales query count with the rendered list.

changedFields.before: Repeated per-assignment reads make query count grow with the page. If only selected volunteers’ skills were shown, an explicit detail read after selection would be smaller.
changedFields.after: Repeated per-assignment reads make query count grow with the page.

changedFields.before: The logs are large and not read on the list screen. If the list needed a small log status, project that status rather than the complete log.
changedFields.after: The logs are large and not read on the list screen.

changedFields.before: Deferred reads can occur outside the stated data scope. If photo count were unbounded, the workflow would need a bounded evidence page rather than an unrestricted eager load.
changedFields.after: Deferred reads can occur outside the stated data scope.

changedFields.before: Eagerly loading bodies and attachments carries unneeded data. If a search snippet were required, project only that bounded snippet.
changedFields.after: Eagerly loading bodies and attachments carries unneeded data.

changedFields.before: Collection-wide history is unrelated to a single asset edit. If an edit action depended on a specific historical rendition, that revision should be loaded explicitly before the action.
changedFields.after: Collection-wide history is unrelated to a single asset edit.

changedFields.before: Per-grant loads repeat access for each displayed permission. If the grant count were unbounded, paginate the grant view instead of loading all rows.
changedFields.after: Per-grant loads repeat access for each displayed permission.

changedFields.before: Fetching all components increases list work for results never opened. If the search displayed component names, project those names or load a bounded summary for the result page.
changedFields.after: Fetching all components increases list work for results never opened.

changedFields.before: Large payloads are not needed for metadata search. If the search needed a digest, project the digest field rather than loading the binary content.
changedFields.after: Large payloads are not needed for metadata search.

changedFields.before: The dashboard need not transfer all underlying records. If the total were calculated from a domain rule not expressible as an aggregate, use an explicitly scoped domain query.
changedFields.after: The dashboard need not transfer all underlying records.

changedFields.before: The entire history is not consumed by this operation. If the balance must be recomputed from all allocations, that becomes an explicit aggregate requirement rather than an implicit graph load.
changedFields.after: The entire history is not consumed by this operation.

mechanicalCheck.scope: Mechanical schema/count/taxonomy/identity correspondence, actual scoring/reversal and exact wrong-diagnostic bindings only; no semantic or identity-action acceptance
